scope: User-requested extension to two-echelon supply chains with six separately specified constraint families and modern large-scale LP methods.
notes: Pilot seeds 0,1,2 are excluded from main results.
Dense educational simplex methods run only through 162 original route variables; not-run rows are not failures.
All methods use the same original LP and final certificate. Standard-form slacks are internal only.
Timing includes setup, solver iterations and checks, but excludes instance calibration, input serialization and plotting.
OR-Tools PDLP model-build time is separately archived and included in total time.
No large-scale superiority claim is assumed in advance; failures and limits are retained.
Ablations are separate diagnostics and do not tune the reported main algorithm.
development_note: Earlier seeds 1101,2202,3303,4404,5505 and pilot 42 exposed poor RHS normalization of PDHG and the MPSolver wrapper returning no iterate at a time limit. Final evaluation uses fresh seeds, native PDLP Python API, and coefficient-based diagonal preconditioning without RHS normalization. RHS-scaled PDHG is retained as an ablation. All algorithms and parameters are fixed before this held-out run.
